StudyRoom.title: StudyRoom
StudyRoom.description: A real-time 2D Study Battle Royale match room identified by a 4-letter uppercase room code.

hostId.description: Client-generated host identifier for authoritative lobby and bot state control.

title.description: Title of the study battle royale session.

targetPlayers.description: Target lobby size before bot backfill (e.g., 20).

countdownEndsAtMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the 15s pre-match lobby countdown finishes.

matchStartedAtMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the battle royale arena match started.

arenaSeed.description: Deterministic seed used by all clients to lay out identical obstacles and crates.

questions.description: List of 1 to 50 multiple-choice quiz questions used in Study Crates and Knowledge Terminals.

winnerId.description: ID of the winning player or bot once the match finishes.

winnerName.description: Display name of the match winner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest room state update.

StudyPlayer.title: StudyPlayer
StudyPlayer.description: A human participant inside a 2D Study Battle Royale room with real-time position, combat stats, and quiz accuracy.

playerId.description: Unique player identifier within the room.

mmr.description: Player's competitive MMR entering the match.

isHost.description: Whether this participant is the room host.

alive.description: Whether the player is currently alive in the arena.

kills.description: Number of eliminations in this match.

hasMedallion.description: Whether the player holds a Bozz Medallion (shield regen + gold minimap ring).

questionsCorrect.description: Number of crate/terminal questions answered correctly.

questionsAttempted.description: Total number of crate/terminal questions attempted.

x.description: Current world X coordinate inside the 2D arena.

y.description: Current world Y coordinate inside the 2D arena.

exposedUntilMs.description: Epoch ms until minimap exposure ends after a wrong quiz answer.

placement.description: Final placement rank (1-20, or 0 while active).

lastShotId.description: Identifier of most recent projectile fired by this player for remote rendering.

lastShotX.description: Spawn X coordinate of the most recent shot.

lastShotY.description: Spawn Y coordinate of the most recent shot.

lastShotVx.description: Velocity X of the most recent shot.

lastShotVy.description: Velocity Y of the most recent shot.

lastShotAtMs.description: Epoch ms of the most recent shot.

joinedAt.description: Server timestamp when the player joined.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync update.

StudyWorldState.title: StudyWorldState
StudyWorldState.description: Authoritative synced bot states, AI Mini-Bozzes, Firewall Cover walls, crate cooldown locks, and kill feed for a Bozz Battles room.

miniBozzes.description: AI Mini-Bozzes guarding major POIs (up to 4).

firewalls.description: Deployed temporary Firewall Cover walls (up to 24).

crateStates.description: Locked or depleted crate/terminal timers synced across players.

killFeed.description: Most recent elimination and achievement feed entries (up to 10).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest world snapshot.

BattleProfile.title: BattleProfile
BattleProfile.description: Persistent ranked MMR and competitive tier progression for a Bozz Battles player.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest ranked update.

/studyRooms/{roomCode}.description: Live Bozz Battles rooms keyed by 4-letter uppercase join codes.

/studyRooms/{roomCode}/players/{playerId.description: Human participants inside a live Bozz Battles room.

/studyRooms/{roomCode}/world/{docId}.description: Authoritative bot, Mini-Bozz, Firewall Cover, crate lock, and kill feed state for the room.

/battleProfiles/{profileId}.description: Competitive ELO/MMR and tier progression records.
